tagline: Meet the BB28 houseguests — draft night is next.

seasonCalendar.notes: Family draft picks are locked, including Angela Murray and Rick Devens as Claghorns picks. Dee Valladares is currently undrafted pending family discussion.

houseguests.name: Ashley Trail
houseguests.bio: Ashley Trail is a 24-year-old bartender from Chicago, IL.
houseguests.notes: Evicted Week 1 by a unanimous 14-0 vote.

houseguests.name: Barrett Pfeiffer
houseguests.bio: Barrett Pfeiffer is a 27-year-old jumbotron Engineer from Texas.

houseguests.name: Chuk Anyanwu
houseguests.bio: Chuk Anyanwu is a 27-year-old supply Chain Analyst from Dallas, TX.
houseguests.notes: Evicted Week 5 by a 9-1 vote after Haley Thogmartin won the BB Blockbuster.

houseguests.name: Drew Campbell
houseguests.bio: Drew Campbell is a 22-year-old dental Assistant.

houseguests.name: Haley Thogmartin
houseguests.bio: Haley Thogmartin is a 29-year-old telemedicine Exec.
houseguests.notes: Week 4 Head of Household. Nominated Melody Morris, Drew Campbell, and Taylor Brown; named Lyric Medeiros as the replacement nominee after Taylor used the Veto. Won the Week 5 BB Blockbuster and came off the block.

houseguests.name: Jason De Puy
houseguests.bio: Jason De Puy is a 35-year-old drag Queen from West Hollywood, CA.
houseguests.notes: Evicted Week 3 by a unanimous 12-0 vote after Mallory Aurichio won the BB Blockbuster.

houseguests.name: Kamu Kirk
houseguests.bio: Kamu Kirk is a 32-year-old mMA Fighter from Phoenix, AZ.
houseguests.notes: Week 3 Head of Household. Won the Week 5 Power of Veto and kept the nominations the same.

houseguests.name: LaTrice Verrett
houseguests.bio: LaTrice Verrett is a 58-year-old boutique salesperson from Maplewood, NJ.
houseguests.notes: Won the Week 5 Head of Household wall competition, becoming the oldest HOH winner in Big Brother history.

houseguests.name: Lyric Medeiros
houseguests.bio: Lyric Medeiros is a 25-year-old attorney from Honolulu, HI.
houseguests.notes: Evicted Week 4 by an 8-3 vote after Drew Campbell won the BB Blockbuster. Previously saved from the block in Weeks 2 and 3 and won the Week 3 Power of Veto.

houseguests.name: Mallory Aurichio
houseguests.bio: Mallory Aurichio is a 24-year-old rocket Scientist from Washington, NJ.
houseguests.notes: Week 1 Power of Veto winner and Week 3 BB Blockbuster winner.

houseguests.name: Melody Morris
houseguests.bio: Melody Morris is a 24-year-old game Show Host from Maricopa, AZ.

houseguests.name: Rome Seymour
houseguests.bio: Rome Seymour is a 28-year-old pickleball Coach from Delray Beach, FL.
houseguests.notes: Evicted Week 2 by a 12-1 vote after Jason De Puy won the BB Blockbuster.

houseguests.name: Taylor Brown
houseguests.bio: Taylor Brown is a 27-year-old elementary School Counselor from Deerfield Beach, FL.
houseguests.notes: Won the Week 4 Power of Veto and used it on herself.

houseguests.name: Yash Patel
houseguests.bio: Yash Patel is a 24-year-old financial Analyst from Monroe, NJ.

houseguests.name: Angela Murray
houseguests.bio: Angela Murray is a Big Brother 26 alum joining the BB28 draft board as a returnee pick.

houseguests.name: Rick Devens
houseguests.bio: Rick Devens is a Survivor: Edge of Extinction fan favorite joining the BB28 draft board as a crossover pick.
houseguests.notes: Week 2 Head of Household and Power of Veto winner. Received the Week 3 Diamond Power of Veto from the BB Time Capsule.

houseguests.name: Dee Valladares
houseguests.bio: Dee Valladares entered the BB28 house, won the first HOH, and is assigned to CA Stirmans under the first-eviction draft rule.
houseguests.notes: Assigned to CA Stirmans after their houseguest Ashley Trail became the first evictee.

weeklyResults.label: Week 1
weeklyResults.notes: Mallory won the Power of Veto. Yash won the BB Blockbuster and came off the block. Ashley was evicted 14-0.

weeklyResults.label: Week 2
weeklyResults.notes: Rick Devens won the Power of Veto and used it on Lyric Medeiros. Jason De Puy won the BB Blockbuster, and Rome Seymour was evicted 12-1.

weeklyResults.label: Week 3
weeklyResults.notes: Kamu Kirk won Head of Household. Rick Devens received the Diamond Power of Veto from the BB Time Capsule. Lyric Medeiros won the Power of Veto and used it on herself, making Jason De Puy the replacement nominee. Mallory Aurichio won the BB Blockbuster, and Jason De Puy was evicted 12-0.

weeklyResults.label: Week 4
weeklyResults.notes: Haley Thogmartin won Head of Household and nominated Melody Morris, Drew Campbell, and Taylor Brown. Taylor won the Power of Veto and used it on herself; Haley named Lyric Medeiros as the replacement nominee. Drew won the BB Blockbuster, and Lyric was evicted 8-3.

weeklyResults.label: Week 5
weeklyResults.notes: LaTrice “Lala” Verrett won Head of Household and nominated Haley Thogmartin, Barrett Pfeiffer, and Chuk Anyanwu. Kamu Kirk won the Power of Veto and kept the nominations the same. Haley won the BB Blockbuster, and Chuk was evicted 9-1.
